key.name: visualizer-location
key.description: Location of visualizer

key.name: total-spects-band
key.description: Total number of bars drawn. In symmetric mode every frequency band is drawn twice.

key.name: visualizer-orientation
key.description: Which edge of the visualizer the bars grow from

key.name: spect-over-ride-bool
key.summary: Deprecated: override the number of bands
key.description: Deprecated. Migrated to total-spects-band at startup.

key.name: spect-over-ride
key.description: Deprecated. Migrated to total-spects-band at startup.

key.name: always-on-top
key.summary: Make Visualizer appear on top of everything
key.description: Make Visualizer appear on top of everything

key.name: visualizer-color
key.description: change color of visualiser

key.name: fill-visualizer
key.description: Deprecated. Migrated to visualizer-style (area) at startup.

key.name: glow-effect
key.description: Draw a colored glow around the visualizer

key.name: glow-color
key.description: Color used for the visualizer glow

key.name: spect-value-expanded
key.description: Deprecated. The override row no longer exists.

key.name: visualizer-style
key.description: Bars, filled curve or line

key.name: mirror
key.description: Mirror the spectrum around the centre, bass in the middle

key.name: color-mode
key.description: One colour, a gradient between two colours, or colours taken from the album cover of the playing track

key.name: visualizer-color2
key.description: End of the gradient (also used when no album cover is available)

key.name: frequency-scale
key.description: Linear, or logarithmic (closer to how we hear, more room for the bass)

key.name: fps
key.description: Updates per second while the visualizer is visible

key.name: smoothing
key.description: How much rapid movement in the bars is reduced (0 = instant response)

key.name: decay
key.description: How quickly the bars fall (0 = very slowly, 100 = instantly)

key.name: sensitivity
key.description: Gain applied to the signal (50 = neutral)

key.name: silence-threshold
key.description: Level in dB under which the audio is considered silent and the visualizer hides
